title: Treaty of Fort Stanwix (1784)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Fort Stanwix (1784)", at revision 1382309853, opens: "The Treaty of Fort Stanwix was a treaty finalized on October 22, 1784, between the United States and Native Americans from the six nations of the Haudenosaunee League. It was signed at Fort Stanwix, in present-day Rome, New York, and was the first of several treaties between Native Americans and the United States after the American victory in the Revolutionary War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3536790, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1784 treaty between the United States and representatives of the Iroquois Confederacy". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
